name: Tacky Jacks Seafood Restaurant and Tavern

hours.notes: Open everyday. Hours vary by location: Orange Beach 7:00 AM, Gulf Shores 7:30 AM, Fort Morgan 8:00 AM. Serving Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner Daily

about.description: Tacky Jacks Seafood Restaurant and Tavern operates three waterfront locations in Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, and Fort Morgan, Alabama. The restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily with a casual tavern atmosphere.
about.elevator_pitch: Waterfront seafood restaurant and tavern across three Alabama Gulf Coast locations, serving fresh seafood and comfort food in a fun, casual setting.
about.vibe: Casual, fun, local favorite hangout with waterfront views, live entertainment, and a relaxed tavern atmosphere
